hourly_forward_curve_F_t.constraint: mean of F over each delivery month = observed quote

kappa_per_hour.source: AR(1) phi of the historical M2 fit

sigma_y_normal.source: M2 regime-0 residual sd, AR->OU mapped

sigma_y_stress.source: M2 regime-1 residual sd, AR->OU mapped

scale_P.source: asinh transform scale of the preprocessing

3_fixed_by_assumption.sigma_transfer_rule: delta method: sigma^X_i(t) = sigma^y_i * sqrt(F(t)^2 + scale_P^2)

4_not_identified_without_option_prices.reason: Forward prices constrain only E^Q[P_t], i.e. the first moment. Volatility and regime-transition premia enter the pricing measure through higher moments and the generator, and are not identified by any number of forward quotes. Option premia are required.
4_not_identified_without_option_prices.how_to_identify_later: With observed option premia, hold F(t) fixed (it is already matched) and calibrate sigma multipliers plus eta01/eta10 to the implied-volatility surface: the level of implied vol pins the sigma premium, its term structure and skew pin the transition premia.
